head: d45ab524d

proposals.spec_says: If `spdk_mem_unregister` fails, the method returns the error without calling `cudaHostUnregister`.
proposals.code_does: SPDK failure kept as spdk_err (:1223-1228); cudaHostUnregister always called (:1231); CUDA failure returns CUDA error (:1232-1237); else SPDK error returned (:1239-1242).
proposals.before:
If `spdk_mem_unregister`
  fails, the method returns the error without calling `cudaHostUnregister`.
proposals.after:
If `spdk_mem_unregister`
  fails, the method MUST still call `cudaHostUnregister` (so the CUDA pin
  is not leaked, e.g. when SPDK became active only after the region was
  registered) and then return the SPDK error; if `cudaHostUnregister`
  fails, the method returns the CUDA error. After either error the region
  is no longer CUDA-pinned whenever `cudaHostUnregister` succeeded.
additional_edits: append to FR-016 provenance: *(Backfilled 2026-11-08 from commit `d45ab524d`, review of PR #591: the CUDA step runs even when the SPDK step fails; `src/lib.rs:1218-1242`.)*

proposals.before: Calls `cudaHostRegister` ... then `spdk_mem_register` so NVMe controllers can DMA directly to/from it. / Calls `spdk_mem_unregister` then `cudaHostUnregister`.
proposals.after: Calls `cudaHostRegister` ... then, if an SPDK environment is active ([`crate::is_spdk_env_active`]), `spdk_mem_register` ...; without one CUDA-pinned only. / Calls `spdk_mem_unregister` (only if an SPDK environment is active) then `cudaHostUnregister`; the CUDA step runs even if the SPDK step fails, and the SPDK error is then returned.
